teaser.en: A citrus-family tree with single, Eugenia-like leaves, and one of four plants sharing the Digo name nchikoma.
teaser.sw: Mti wa familia ya michungwa wenye majani mamoja kama ya Eugenia, na mmoja wa mimea minne inayoshiriki jina la Kidigo nchikoma.

summary.en: Vepris eugeniifolia is a shrub or tree of the citrus family found from southern Ethiopia to Tanzania. The Digo call it nchikoma, the same name as the Diphasia tree and two Ehretias.
summary.sw: Vepris eugeniifolia ni kichaka au mti wa familia ya michungwa unaopatikana kutoka kusini mwa Ethiopia hadi Tanzania. Wadigo huuita nchikoma, jina lilelile la mti wa Diphasia na Ehretia mbili.

about.en: *Vepris eugeniifolia* is a shrub or small tree of the citrus family. Unlike most of its relatives, which have leaves of three leaflets, it has single leaves, and the botanical name says they look like those of a *Eugenia*. The leaves are dotted with oil glands and smell aromatic when crushed, and the flowers are small and greenish-white.
about.sw: *Vepris eugeniifolia* ni kichaka au mti mdogo wa familia ya michungwa. Tofauti na mimea mingi ya jamii yake, ambayo ina majani yenye vijani vitatu, huu una majani mamoja, na jina lake la kisayansi linasema yanafanana na yale ya *Eugenia*. Majani yana vitone vya tezi za mafuta na hutoa harufu nzuri yanapopondwa, na maua ni madogo, ya rangi ya kijani-nyeupe.

where.en: It grows in dry forest, thicket and bushland from southern Ethiopia and Somalia through Kenya to Tanzania. Pakia recorded it among the Digo of the south coast.
where.sw: Huota katika misitu mikavu, vichaka vizito na vichakani kutoka kusini mwa Ethiopia na Somalia kupitia Kenya hadi Tanzania. Pakia aliuripoti miongoni mwa Wadigo wa pwani ya kusini.

names.en: Pakia records *nchikoma* for this tree, and also for *Diphasia* sp. A, *Ehretia amoena* and *Ehretia bakeri*. *Diphasia* is in the same family, which may explain part of the overlap. The name's meaning is not explained. No English or Swahili name is recorded. Pakia spells the species '*euginiifolia*'.
names.sw: Pakia anaripoti *nchikoma* kwa mti huu, na pia kwa *Diphasia* sp. A, *Ehretia amoena* na *Ehretia bakeri*. *Diphasia* ni ya familia ileile, jambo linaloweza kueleza sehemu ya mwingiliano huu. Maana ya jina haielezwi. Hakuna jina la Kiingereza wala la Kiswahili lililoripotiwa. Pakia anaiandika spishi hii '*euginiifolia*'.

reason.en: the Eugenia its leaves are compared to
reason.sw: Eugenia ambayo majani yake yanalinganishwa nayo

digo_proposals.name: Nchikoma
digo_proposals.note: also given for Diphasia sp. A, Ehretia amoena, Ehretia bakeri
